NHL personality Barry Melrose, former player and coach, dies at 70

Barry Melrose, a figure in professional ice hockey as a player, coach, and broadcaster, has died at the age of 70. Melrose had a notable career in the sport, including coaching the Los Angeles Kings to the Stanley Cup Final in 1993. He was also recognized for his work as a broadcaster.
